pumpfun.name: fresh_curve
pumpfun.note: an untouched pump.fun curve: the canonical 28 SOL open, 85.005 SOL to graduate

pumpfun.name: completed_curve
pumpfun.note: curve drained, awaiting migration to PumpSwap

pumpfun.name: field_mixing_anomaly
pumpfun.note: the row a peer session measured in production. Given all four reserves this states an unfamiliar opening rather than a broken one -- k against a curve's own opening holds by construction -- so it is reported and still priced

pumpfun.name: stale_base_against_a_known_opening
pumpfun.note: the shape a second writer emitting a partial row really has: the quote side moved in lockstep so the curve classifies as the 30 SOL variant, but the base did not move with it. The opening is known, so k must hold, and it does not

pumpfun.name: virtual_column_holds_the_real_reserve
pumpfun.note: the one signature that survives dropping the constants: no curve opens at zero, so a virtual quote equal to its real counterpart is impossible rather than merely unfamiliar

pumpfun.name: quote_variant_curve
pumpfun.note: pump.fun seeds non-SOL-quoted curves at 4.292 rather than 30; judging one against the SOL opening makes every number wrong

pumpfun.name: quote_variant_traded
pumpfun.note: the same variant after trading, where a narrow band around the opening no longer finds it but the reserve offset still does

pumpfun.name: legacy_truncated_account
pumpfun.note: an account written before `creator` was appended; the prefix still decodes

raydium_launchlab.name: constant_product_fresh
raydium_launchlab.note: a LetsBonk-style pool at creation, seeded with pump.fun's own reserves

raydium_launchlab.name: constant_product_mid
raydium_launchlab.note: 42.5 SOL paid in, reserves still on the k the virtual pair fixed

raydium_launchlab.name: constant_product_migrated
raydium_launchlab.note: curve drained and migrated; graduation price is the raise less the migrate fee over the tokens held back

raydium_launchlab.name: fixed_price
raydium_launchlab.note: a flat curve: the price never moves off virtual_quote / virtual_base

raydium_launchlab.name: linear_half_sold
raydium_launchlab.note: a linear curve halfway through its sellable supply; the slope lives in virtual_base as a Q64 value and quantises hard at u64

meteora_dbc.name: fresh_pool
meteora_dbc.note: a Believe/Bags-style pool at creation: every static number comes off the shared PoolConfig, the pool carries only its sqrt price

meteora_dbc.name: mid_pool
meteora_dbc.note: half the raise paid in and the price moved with it

meteora_dbc.name: migrated_pool
meteora_dbc.note: threshold met and migrated to DAMM

meteora_dbc.name: two_segment_derived_migration_price
meteora_dbc.note: an older config with migration_sqrt_price at zero and a dynamic supply: both the migration price and the total supply have to be walked out of the curve's own segments
